run_LTX2Pipeline_call: run the LTX2Pipeline __call__ method to generate a video with audio from a text prompt
create_LTX2Pipeline_instance: create an LTX2Pipeline instance with scheduler, vae, audio_vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, connectors, transformer, and vocoder
encode_prompt_LTX2Pipeline: encode a text prompt into Gemma3 text encoder hidden state embeddings with attention mask
enhance_prompt_LTX2Pipeline: enhance a text prompt using the Gemma3 text encoder with a system prompt to generate a more detailed prompt
prepare_latents_LTX2Pipeline: prepare video and audio latents by packing, normalizing, and adding noise for the diffusion denoising loop
